subject: general
question: The nitrogen in the ecosystem is circulated by:-
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bacteria**__.

__
 
• The process of conversion of nitrogen (N₂) to ammonia is termed as **nitrogen fixation**.
 
• **Bacteria play a great role in nitrogen fixation**__.
 
• Nitrogen-fixing bacteria inhabit legume root nodules.
 
• Nitrogenase is the enzyme in nitrogen-fixing bacteria that catalyzes the conversion of atmospheric nitrogen into ammonia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Ammonia is first oxidised to nitrite by the bacteria Nitrosomonas or Nitrococcus.
 
• The nitrite is further oxidised to nitrate with the help of the **bacterium Nitrobacter**.
 
• These nitrifying bacteria are chemoautotrophs.
 
• The nitrate thus formed is absorbed by plants and is transported to the leaves.
 
• In leaves, it is reduced to form ammonia that finally forms the amine group of amino acids.
 
• Nitrate present in the soil is also reduced to nitrogen by the process of denitrification. Denitrification is carried by bacteria Pseudomonas and Thiobacillus.
